description: Comprehensive Agave Validator Latency Metrics - Shreds to Geyser/SHM Queue

panels.content:
# Validator Latency Flow (Shreds → Geyser/SHM)

```
┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐
│   NETWORK    │ ──► │  WINDOW SERVICE │ ──► │    BLOCKSTORE    │ ──► │  REPLAY STAGE   │ ──► │    GEYSER    │
│   (Turbine)  │     │   (Shred Recv)  │     │  (Shred Insert)  │     │ (TX Execution)  │     │  (SHM Queue) │
└──────────────┘     └─────────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────────┘     └──────────────┘
      │                      │                        │                        │                      │
      ▼                      ▼                        ▼                        ▼                      ▼
  shred_count         handle_packets_us        insert_shreds_us        replay_active_us         push_latency
  ping_count          shred_receiver_us        write_batch_us          execute_batches_us       ring_buffer
                      num_shreds_received      total_time_ms           fetch_entries_time
                                               (slot completion)
```

**Key Metrics to Watch:**
- `shred_insert_is_full.total_time_ms` - Time from first shred to slot completion
- `replay-slot-stats.replay_total_elapsed` - Total slot replay time
- `replay-loop-timing-stats.replay_active_banks_elapsed_us` - Transaction execution time
